result.title: A Continuous Relaxation of Quantization-Aware Training
result.summary: Quantization is a critical piece of the deployment pipeline in the era of large generative models. Low-bit quantization, particularly 2-bits or sub-2-bits, is a notoriously difficult problem, particularly when using a channelwise quantization scheme which has been shown as a leading candidate for hardware-efficiency. The key challenges with low-bit quantization range from limited quantization levels to saddle points or flat regions in the loss surface. In this paper, we look at the problem of flat quantization loss surfaces through a lens of dynamically changing bitwidth. Unlike existing techniques which either change the bit-precision abruptly or keep it fixed, we propose to gradually alter the bitwidth as the model trains. To this end, we propose RelaxQAT, a continuous relaxation of the QAT process. We also provide simple theoretical and empirical insights behind why RelaxQAT helps the QAT performance. Our extensive experiments demonstrate up to 6.3% average accuracy gains on vision and up to 7.7% better average accuracy on natural language tasks, compared to the leading QAT methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RelaxQAT，把量化感知训练中的位宽改为随训练渐进变化的连续松弛，以缓解低位量化的平坦损失面问题，并在视觉与语言任务上报告了相对现有 QAT 方法的准确率提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「连续松弛＋位宽渐进退火」的离散—连续训练调度，可能为 LVR 中潜状态由连续表征逐步收紧到离散或低精度状态、以及避开平坦损失区的训练监督方式提供可核查的借鉴线索。
